$comment: Source of truth: Holochain DHT (sub-shape of attestation:device-health's evidence_json.summary_metric). Category A. Replaces infrastructure DNA's HealthAttestation entry type. Raw heartbeats stay observation-layer (per spec §6.4 + observation-layer sibling spec).
title: DeviceHealthAttestationMetadata
description: Per-subtype metadata for attestation:device-health (infrastructure). Derived summary of device/doorway health across an observation window. Raw heartbeat data lives on the operational observation layer, not on the DHT.

sample_count.description: Number of raw observation samples summarized into this attestation

summary_value.description: Free-form summary value (e.g., '99.97%' for uptime). Renderers interpret per health_metric.
